scene:kemkem.title: The painting of The Kem Kem rivers
scene:kemkem.context: The painter was free to imagine only: a hot, hazy dry-season afternoon under a pale sky; An ordinary hot afternoon on the river: Spinosaurus at the water’s edge, two big meat-eaters on the far bank, pterosaurs overhead. Nothing in particular is happening — and that is the point: no place on Earth today has so many big hunters.. Everything else comes from the evidence.
